choices.why: This dark-brown wood rectangular table is 198 cm long, so it seats six to eight, and its tapered legs give it a warm, classic-but-current look that suits the hardwood floor.
These high-back chairs are upholstered in grey heathered fabric and have dark wooden legs that match the table; three sets of two give six chairs, and at 58 cm wide they fit comfortably around it.
The 51 cm white drum-shade chandelier has enough presence over the table and gives soft, warm light, a classic shape with a current feel.
This four-door sideboard has a warm dark-brown wood tone and cane panels, which suits the stair wall and matches the finish of the table and the stair railing.

answer.why: The dark wood of the table, sideboard and chair legs echoes the floor, the kitchen cabinets and the stair railing. The grey upholstery and the white drum shade soften the space against the cream walls, for a warm look that is classic but current.
